Jubba Sahni Park (Amar Shaheed Jubba Sahni Park) is a well-documented children's park in Mithanpura, Muzaffarpur, named after freedom fighter Jubba Sahni of Chainpur village (hanged 11 March 1944 after the 16 August 1942 burning of the Meenapur police station). Local business listings describe the park as located 'off Hanuman mandir', indicating a Hanuman shrine adjacent to the park - the most plausible referent for this row. Deity, history, festivals and hours are undocumented; coordinates are approximate (park anchor).
